name: looking_at
summary: What the player's crosshair is on: the thing the 3 m interaction ray hits, the button or slot under it, plus the view and a longer look ray. Read only.

help.text: Returns player, target (null for nothing, terrain or past 3 m), interactable, view and hit. Hand target.reference_id to any other tool. Needs the player's view.

target.text: target {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, custom_name, kind (item, dynamic: a movable thing that is not an item, structure, entity, other), runtime_type, position, distance_m, is_device (logic tools take it), has_atmosphere, parent (the holder of a thing in a slot)}. A structure adds rotation {facing, up, euler} in the forms place_structure takes (facing and up null when turned off the grid's axes), body {origin, render_box, centre_offset, grid_box, grid_cells} and facing_me.

interactable.summary: The button, switch, port or slot under the crosshair.
interactable.text: interactable: null, or what the hand would use: {action (Activate, OnOff, Open, Slot1...), display_name, contextual_name (the tooltip name), state, slot {slot_index, slot_name, occupant}}.

view.summary: The camera: eye, axes, yaw and pitch.
view.text: view {eye, forward, right, up, yaw_deg (0 along +z, 90 +x), pitch_deg (up positive), source (local or remote), age_s, axes {forward, right, up, back, left, down: the world axes nearest the player's level heading, so a metre forward runs along the floor; look: the axis nearest the look itself}, ambiguous (heading within 10 degrees of a diagonal), third_person, seated}.

hit.summary: The longer look ray: point, face, cells.
hit.text: hit casts the same ray up to max_distance_m (default 10, max 50), left out when it hits nothing: {point, distance_m, normal, face, face_plane ("z=668" when within 0.3 m of a 2 m face plane), cell_2m (on your side), small_cell (where a piece mounted there would stand), support (grid_survey's support letter), thing, local_on_target {right_m, up_m, forward_m}}.

max_distance_m.description: How far hit casts the look ray; default 10, max 50.
